description: Transvaalbuurt 1931 two-storey rows (Vaalrivierstraat 2-22 and 3-9, Kraaipanstraat 50-52 and 63-65): 8 m brown brick fronts of a 3.3 m ground storey and a 3.0 m upper storey under a flat roof with a thin light eaves slab at about 6.3 m; three white box-framed windows with a top light per storey, and at one end the paired portiek doors (blue, double) under a flat canopy with a small window over them; pands mirror in pairs about the shared door group

match.note: BAG 1931 on all five faces; 8.0-8.2 m pands, 3DBAG eaves 6.0-6.3 m, bouwlagen 3 (2 on 22: the roof slab counts), roof max 9.1-9.5 m (chimneys, roof plant). The five-storey heads of Vaalrivierstraat 2 and 3 (eaves 14.7-14.9 m) and 4 (roof max 14.9 m) are other buildings.

flat-overhang.note: Vaalrivierstraat 6-12: a thin light grey eaves slab 8.0-8.4 m on the strip (foot at 1.8 m), about 0.35 m out

door-left.note: the portiek doors on the left axis (blue double doors, two per pand, a group of four with the mirrored neighbour) under a flat dark canopy at 4.1-4.4 m on the strip; mirrored when the strip reads them on the right

rhythm.identicalBays: no: the door axis is wider and carries a small upper window
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: doors + three windows | 1: small window + three windows
rhythm.symmetry: mirrored in pairs about the shared door group
rhythm.groundFloor: the portiek door pair under a flat canopy at one end, three windows
rhythm.roofline: flat, a thin light eaves slab

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2020-04-29 at 40 px/m, 1 m grid on 12 and 10 (8.0 m each; facade foot at 1.8 m on the strip): doors 1.8-4.1 m, four in a 4.5 m group across the party wall of 14/12 and of 10/8, a dark canopy 4.1-4.4 m; ground windows 2.3-4.35 m, upper windows 5.85-7.35 m, 1.4-1.6 m wide in deep white frames with a top light, a 0.9 m light over the doors at 6.0-6.9 m; eaves slab 8.0-8.4 m
strip.jpg 2020-04-29: the same row, door groups at 20/22 and 16/18

schemaLimits: two doors per pand (a double portiek door pair); one door is drawn
the plant boxes on the door canopy are not drawn
notes: Palette: the type default is a mid brown; every placed pand takes its trim-normalised strip wall (auto-place measuredPalette).
Roof: red-tile. Kraaipanstraat 63-65 (2020-04-29) shows the orange-red tile roof rising behind the eaves slab; 3DBAG roof max 9.1-9.5 m over 6.0-6.3 m eaves.
